independenceDeclaration.statement: Every row was independently solved from its EN/ZH prompt. Existing oracle, response audit, QA status, candidate verdict, and learner explanation were not treated as mathematical proof.

reviewMethod: Read every EN and ZH prompt side by side and checked exact mathematical equivalence, quantities, qualifiers, requested parts, and response format.

Independently recalculated all decimal, fraction, integer, order-of-operations, application, factorisation, divisibility, prime/composite, H.C.F., and L.C.M. results; checked complete method traces where the prompt requires working.
Reviewed every one of the 617 accepted-answer surface forms for mathematical validity and compliance with requested method or representation requirements.
For all 24 multiple-choice rows, evaluated every option independently in both languages and recorded the unique correct zero-based option index.
Reviewed both learner explanations for substantive correct reasoning and scanned the learner-facing explanation fields for internal QA, S18, audit, oracle, pending-review, or grader prose.
Checked grade/topic plausibility against the assigned P4 decimal/quadrilateral/direction, P5 fraction, and S1 basic-computation/number-theory content.
Re-scanned learner-facing topic metadata and verified that indices 241..247 contain the exact malformed Traditional Chinese title “四邊形 (三 )”.

checkDefinitions.exactEnZhPromptEquivalence: The two prompts ask the same mathematical task with matching numbers, units, conditions, and response format.
checkDefinitions.unambiguousSolvability: The prompt supplies enough information and has a determinate answer under the stated convention.
checkDefinitions.canonicalAnswerCorrect: Independent solution agrees with the stored canonical answer exactly in mathematical meaning.
checkDefinitions.everyAcceptedAnswerFormMathematicallyVal: Every stored acceptedAnswers entry was inspected and is a valid response to this prompt.
checkDefinitions.methodAndRepresentationRequirementsSatis: Accepted structured responses retain every explicitly requested part, method, trace, explanation, or notation.
checkDefinitions.multipleChoiceOptionsAlignedAndUniquelyC: EN/ZH option arrays correspond and each locale has exactly one correct option.
checkDefinitions.substantiveCorrectExplanationZh: Traditional Chinese explanation contains correct learner-facing reasoning, not merely a conclusion.
checkDefinitions.substantiveCorrectExplanationEn: English explanation contains correct learner-facing reasoning, not merely a conclusion.
checkDefinitions.noInternalQaOrS18ProseInLearnerExplanati: Neither learner explanation exposes internal QA, S18, audit, oracle, grader, pending, or review instructions.
checkDefinitions.gradeAndTopicPlausible: The mathematical demand is plausible for the stored HK grade/topic.
checkDefinitions.learnerFacingMetadataClean: The learner-facing topic title has normalized spacing and punctuation.
